# Building a FastAPI Application with Okteto - Part 4 - Preview Environments


Welcome back to our video series - Building a FastAPI Application with Okteto. This is Part 4: Preview Environments.


In this video, you’ll learn how to automatically create[preview environments](https://www.okteto.com/preview-environments) for every pull request of your application using GitHub actions and Okteto.


New to the series? Don't worry, the previous episodes are available on our YouTube channel:


- [Part I: Intro](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NJpcKkQ3Bn0)
- [Part II: Routes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ScWyTBy9N94&t=123s)
- [Part III: Databases](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VuvPDApyGek&t=8s)


Be sure to subscribe to our[YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXYaFkiXHdBA7fjKgEgSJfA) to be the first to know when new videos go live!
